description: I develop digital products with a strong focus on user experience, combining design and development to deliver clear, intuitive, and well-structured interfaces.
aboutP1: Graduated in Information Systems, with a focus on web development and experience in both front-end development and design. I work on creating digital products, following all stages of development, from concept to implementation.
aboutP2: I have a stronger affinity for front-end development, but I am also interested in working as a full-stack developer, always seeking to grow technically and expand my knowledge across different technologies.
aboutP3: I have an intermediate level of English and knowledge of design, which allows me to contribute to the creative process as well as to the development of functional, intuitive, and well-structured interfaces.
aboutP4: I am driven by curiosity and continuous learning, qualities that lead me to explore new solutions and take on challenges with responsibility and commitment.
descPawio: Paw.io is a veterinary clinic management application focused on organizing appointments, patients, owners, and clinical information through a complete desktop interface.
descGreep: Greep is an RSS feed reader with a minimalist interface, allowing users to organize sources, search articles, save content, and keep track of their reading.
descFormAcademy: Form Academy is a modern fitness academy website focused on presenting plans, classes, trainers, and locations through a visual and responsive interface.
descMendesAssociados: Mendes e Associados is an institutional website for a law firm, focused on presenting its services, practice areas, and legal content through a professional interface.
altMendesAssociados: Mendes e Associados project home section
descOnTarget: On Target is a project that simulates a modern e-commerce platform, focusing on responsive layout, user authentication, and a shopping cart.
altOnTarget: Initial section of the On Target project
descFactusBlog: A modern and smooth news website focused on a simple reading experience, featuring user authentication and tools such as favorite posts and an editing area for authors.
altFactusBlog: Initial section of the Factus Blog project
descClimbUp: A visual and minimalist climbing website created to practice Tailwind CSS, highlighting mountain landscapes and basic information about each route.
altClimbUp: Initial section of the Climb Up project
descForYou: For You is a news website with a minimalist design and neutral colors, focused on a simple experience, featuring news saving, user interactions, and an administrative panel for content publishing.
altForYou: Initial section of the For You project
descReadingManager: Reading Manager is an application for organizing reading materials and tracking progress, allowing users to categorize content, register bookmarks, and view statistics in a simple and intuitive way.
altReadingManager: Initial section of the Reading Manager project
descFeedbash: Feedbash is a platform focused on sharing content via links, allowing users to receive feedback and ratings in a practical way, with authentication and interaction features.
altFeedbash: Initial section of the Feedbash project
descOcenaLibrary: Ocean Library is a fictional library project created to provide a modern, intuitive, and functional experience for managing books, events, and news, meeting the needs of both users and platform administrators.
altOcenaLibrary: Initial section of the OcenaLibrary project
